title: Ukraine strike brings down part of the bridge between Russia and Crimea
caption:
A Ukrainian strike brought down part of the road section of the bridge linking Russia to annexed Crimea, Ukraine's military says, in the second attack on the bridge in two nights. President Zelensky called it an unprecedented operation, while the Kremlin says the bridge will be rebuilt. Overnight, Russian missiles hit Kyiv, killing at least two people.

One story. Twice a day. Follow for the next edition.
